description.mn: Afnan His Highness White: Эрэгтэйчүүдэд зориулсан модлог үнэр (EDP). Эхний ноот: кардамон, ягаан чинжүү, зира, задийн самар, гүргэм; зүрхний ноот: герань; суурь ноот: пачули, хүж.
description.en: His Highness White Cologne by Afnan, Exude confidence and masculinity with each and every step by incorporating His Highness White, a smooth, sweet cologne, into your everyday wardrobe. This unique fragrance opens up with top notes of cardamom, pink pepper, cumin, nutmeg, saffron, pink pepper. The middle notes offer a softer experience, with floral touches of geranium and a dash of spicy myrrh. Base notes include touches of patchouli, incense, almond, musk and sandalwood, creating a smoky and spicy finish unlike any other. This well-loved fragrance is ideal for chilly days and upscale occasions of all types.
